findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and ceased trading on 22 December 2025.
A members' voluntary liquidation was recorded, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
There are two current officers, including one director appointed on 11 May 2022 whose name is recorded as 'C. BROWN says you should not trade with this company'.
The director has 11 other appointments across 11 other companies, comprising 8 active, 2 dissolved, and 1 in liquidation.
One person with significant control is recorded as CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding between 75 and 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
Accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023 and the confirmation statement to 5 March 2025, with next due dates not recorded.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 302 (91000303) is dissolved following a members' voluntary liquidation that concluded on 22 December 2025.
